RATIONALE:
Q1: The design says to reuse the existing classifier in `scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py` and not write a second one. That classifier already limits itself to `MAX_FAILED_JOBS_CLASSIFIED = 10` annotation reads (line 148, checked at lines 470 and 535), using `failure_annotations` (line 423) and `shutdown_only_annotations` (line 195, whose comment says a `timeout-minutes` cancellation leaves an annotation that fails it). Option A therefore uses a limit the repo already accepts and keeps the issue's "timeout annotation → failure" test. It also fails closed: more cancelled jobs than the cap, or an annotation read that fails, still posts `failure`, so a stale `success` never outlives a run that may have timed out. Option B leaves a known false-red path in place. Option C has no limit on API calls, which breaks the API-call rules in §14. With A, the "at most one extra API call" wording in the issue's Automation section becomes "one jobs call plus at most 10 annotation requests, only on the cancelled-and-no-failure path". The planner should update the header comment of `scripts/ci_final_status.sh` (its "API calls" block starts at line 35 and today lists only the status POST) to say this.
